name: Find Love
source:
"Find Love" is part of the "Uniform Bishoujo Grand Prix" series. There are meetings prepared with 35 beautiful girls from all over Japan dressed in uniforms. All that's needed is solving a small puzzle each time. For PC version there is also erotic development involved.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《Find Love》是“制服美少女大奖赛”系列的一作。你将与来自日本各地、身穿制服的35名美少女见面。每次只需解开一个小谜题即可。PC版还包含色情剧情。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
